//: Type-checks the TESTS, which the build config cannot: its `include` is src
only, because `rootDir` roots the emit at the common ancestor of every input
and test/ in scope would move dist/ under a directory package.json does not
Tests import from dist/ rather than src/, so this needs a build first — which
is why `typecheck` and `test` both run `tsc` before it. Checking them against
the emitted .d.ts is the point: it is the surface consumers actually get.
